text: Supported info types (add values): Age leap years: age counts completed calendar years, rather dividing elapsed days 365.25. someone born 29 February, age increases 29 February leap years 1 March non-leap years. example, someone born 29 February 2000 23 28 February 2024 24 29 February 2024; remain 24 28 February 2025 turn 25 1 March 2025. numeric reference year still defaults 1 January, including leap years. valid means, : valid = TRUE requires exactly two things: cleaned value ten digits, digits encode real calendar date official century rules. modulus-11 check part valid. Since 2007 CPR office assigned numbers without modulus-11 control, birth dates run mod-11-compatible sequence numbers. cpr.dk states "fuldt ud gyldige personnumre" (far assigned persons born certain 1 January dates 1960 1990s). failed mod-11 therefore make CPR number invalid. Validators reject mod-11 wrongly reject real, living people. check still reported separately mod11, works data quality signal: high failure rate older data suggests keying errors. official assignment series start sequence number 0001, 0000 never occurs practice. rejected , since date check documented criterion. Century detection follows official CPR rules based digit 7 two-digit year component (see table source code). Input tolerance: CPR column standardised clean_cpr(): dashes spaces stripped nine-digit numbers zero-padded left (recovering values lost leading zero Excel). CPR column returned data frame always returned standardised 10-digit format xxxxxxxxxx.
